Class GetLocalizationStatusesResponse

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.yarn.api.protocolrecords.GetLocalizationStatusesResponse
@Public @Unstable public abstract class GetLocalizationStatusesResponse extends Object
The response sent by the node manager to an application master when localization statuses are requested.
